source_note: Named rule catalogue (Session 4). One entry per thing the deterministic engine actually checks: each incompatible hazard pair in hazard_rules_v1.json, the overhead-work check, the fire-watch capacity limit, one per certificate kind, and one per judgment-flag trigger (category 'judgment': a call the engine can't make, routed to a person, never a violation). Contacts are ROLES, never named people. Citation 'verified' follows navsea_8010_psns_v2014.json's convention: true only for an entry read against the primary source (the three NAVSEA entries were, on 2026-08-08, ADR-023). Every 29 CFR section below was added in Session 4 from general knowledge of Part 1915's structure and is verified=false until someone reads the eCFR text for it and flips it. These citations explain a rule; they never decide one -- detection stays in deconfliction.py and certificates.py.

rules.title: Hot work in or adjacent to a confined or enclosed space
rules.note: 29 CFR 1915.14 covers hot work in confined/enclosed spaces (Subpart B). NAVSEA8010-4.4.4 (multiple levels) is cited because hot material can travel between the spaces involved.

rules.title: Hot work in the same envelope as work aloft
rules.note: Falling slag or sparks reaching staging or workers aloft; NAVSEA8010-4.4.4 requires a fire watch at each level unless positive means prevent spread or fall of hot material.

rules.title: Work aloft concurrent with fall-protection work in the same envelope
rules.note: Known Debt (ARCHITECTURE.md): working aloft requires fall protection, so this pair can flag a compliant configuration. Kept as a review prompt, not a violation finding.

rules.title: Overhead work above other work with no vertical deconfliction confirmed
rules.note: No specific 29 CFR section mapped yet for overhead work above other crews; left uncited rather than guessed. Fires when one package is aloft or over the side and the other shares its frame range.

rules.title: Fire watch covering more than four concurrent hot workers
rules.note: Limit of four from NAVSEA8010-4.4.3, verified against the primary source (ADR-023).

rules.title: Hot work permit must cover the whole work window
Confined space entry permit must cover the whole work window
Fall protection plan must cover the whole work window
Marine chemist certificate must cover the whole work window
Competent person inspection must cover the whole work window
Hot work near, but not overlapping, a confined or enclosed space
rules.note: Judgment flag, not a violation. Fires when hot work and a confined space run concurrently within JUDGMENT_ADJACENCY_FRAMES frames of each other without overlapping, which detection (WS-HZ-001) does not flag (Known Debt: no adjacency tolerance). The frame threshold is a notional review prompt, not a regulatory distance.

rules.title: Simultaneous confined-space entries in the same space
rules.note: Judgment flag, not a violation. Two concurrent confined-space packages in the same compartment or overlapping frames; detection has no confined_space/confined_space pair (eval gap-simultaneous-confined-space-entries). The Gas Free Engineer decides whether the entries are coordinated.

rules.title: Hot work or confined-space package with no location
rules.note: Judgment flag, not a violation. A package with no compartment and no complete frame range can never be spatially deconflicted, so it is routed to a person instead of being silently treated as unlinked. No citation: this is a data-completeness prompt, not a regulatory requirement.

rules.title: Package assigned to a crew that does not exist
rules.note: Planning constraint, not a safety regulation; uncited on purpose. An unknown crew_id can't be checked for windows or double-booking, so it is reported rather than skipped.

rules.title: Contractor work outside the contractor's allowed windows
rules.note: Planning constraint, not a safety regulation; uncited on purpose. The whole work window must fall inside the union of the contractor's windows; an unscheduled contractor package cannot be verified and is reported.

rules.title: Work scheduled outside the shift calendar
rules.note: Planning constraint, not a safety regulation; uncited on purpose. Every part of the work window must fall inside some shift; the uncovered time is reported.

rules.title: One crew booked on overlapping packages
rules.note: Planning constraint, not a safety regulation; uncited on purpose. Back-to-back packages (one ends when the next starts) are not double-booked.

rules.title: Concurrent gas-free packages with no common location coordinate
rules.note: Judgment flag, not a violation (review-01 R07). One package is located only by compartment and the other only by frames, so neither detection nor WS-JF-001 can tell whether they are near each other. Data-completeness prompt; no citation.

rules.title: Gas-free work identified by spatial flag or permit but missing from the hazard list
rules.note: Judgment flag, not a violation (review-01 R08). Detection reads only hazard_categories, so a confined-space entry marked by is_enclosed_or_confined or an entry permit, or hot work marked only by a hot-work permit, is invisible to WS-HZ rules. Routed so a person can correct the classification. No citation.
